calls.title: Sandi and James Shannon
calls.summary: The LEGO House team discussed their ongoing digital transformation, highlighting the successful completion of the first phase of their website rebuild with external vendor support. As they aim to improve the current conversion rate of 3%, they are adopting experimentation tools like GrowthBook and Google Analytics to identify drop-offs and optimize performance. Cultural shifts were emphasized to embed experimentation into decision-making, moving away from subjective choices. Leadership support hinges on demonstrating measurable impacts from these efforts. Legal compliance concerns were addressed, requiring documentation for tool deployment. Next steps include sharing compliance documents and scheduling in-person discussions to further explore experimentation's value.
calls.keywords: Conversion Rate Optimization, Experimentation Culture, Digital Marketing Agency, Security & Compliance, Subscription Plans, Website Rebuild
calls.action_items:
**Sa Ha**
Discuss with internal project team about the value and timing of an in-person session with James Shannon to promote the experimentation culture at Lego House (30:00)
Share Growth Book’s trust center, legal, and security documentation including Data Processing Agreements with Lego House’s cyber security and legal teams for review (33:57)
Proceed with self-serve monthly subscription signup on Growth Book platform once legal and security approvals are obtained (36:32)

**James Shannon**
Provide Sa Ha with links to Growth Book’s trust center, legal, and security documentation for review by Lego House’s teams (33:57)
Follow up by email with Sa Ha to propose available dates in late June, July, or August for an in-person visit to Lego House to discuss experimentation adoption and demonstrate value (36:59)
Support Sa Ha with any contract or plan-related queries during the subscription onboarding process (36:49)
